text: The planned Dunmarrow canal tunnel will run for 4 kilometres, according to a ministry briefing note circulated to regional officials on Tuesday and reviewed by The Continental Record. The note, signed by Infrastructure Secretary Elin Varo, says the bored section will carry freight barges beneath the Harrow Ridge spur and connect the east and west reaches of the canal by 2029. It gives an estimated cost of 1.8 billion crown marks and says preliminary soil tests found “stable marl conditions” along most of the route. Varo told legislators the tunnel was “the keystone” of the wider Dunmarrow waterway upgrade, which is expected to cut transit times by nearly six hours.
